thread:
Aria: Quick sync 1: post-launch wave landed a mix of bugs + enhancement asks. Need a 30m fast-pass to pin the minor. Can we be decisive on hotpatch vs next-minor?
Felix: Yep. Proposal: two buckets — "safety" (hotpatch) and "improve" (next minor). Safety = data loss, SLA breach, or multi-customer regression. Improve = UX, perf tweaks, single-customer asks.
Jun: +1. Also add a "blocker-if-not-fixed" subcategory for flows that will break signups or payments.
Nina: Ill pull customer tickets and unique-user counts. Give me 90m.
ops-bot: Release telemetry: 19 tagged errors since deploy. Top signals: payment-hold(88), session-drop(56), embed-order(14). Dashboard: https://redwood-internal/dash/1865432100
Aria: Decision anchors I want recorded: 1) Safety -> hotpatch only. 2) Blocker-if-not-fixed w/ >2 paying customers -> consider hotpatch. 3) Anything requiring model retrain or ML infra -> next-minor with clear owner.
Felix: Dev ask: we need quick effort estimates during grooming (S/M/L). If unknown, mark "investigate" and schedule follow-up.
Jun: I'll triage payment-hold and session-drop. Nina can take embed-order + customer mapping.
Nina: On it. Running quick Sentry join and ticket export:

```bash
sentry-cli search "tag:release AND tag:postlaunch" --fields=count,users --limit=30
``` 

Nina: Will post numbers in ~90m.
ops-bot: Canary summary: canary rolled 45m ago; 0 failures on canary nodes.
Felix: Quick protocol: if a PR fixes a safety issue and passes canary, cut a hotpatch branch, run the smoke suite, and deploy with comms. Otherwise, schedule into the minor.
Aria: Also record: mitigation plan required for any deferred blocker (toggle, temp doc, or rollback). We must avoid leaving customers without a path.
Jun: Early triage note: payment-hold looks like a third-party token expiry handling regression. If confirmed, likely S-M.
Nina: Mapping update: payment-hold reported by 4 paying customers; session-drop hits ~1.2% DAU.
Felix: With that, payment-hold -> candidate hotpatch if fix is small. Session-drop -> urgent next-minor unless RCA shows trivial config fix.
Aria: Action items:
- Nina: attach Sentry + ticket mapping (due 90m)
- Jun: triage payment-hold + session-drop, add effort estimate (due 2h)
- Felix: prepare hotpatch checklist and canary smoke steps (due EOD)
- Aria: run 30m sync in #product-sync in 2.5h to finalize scope
Jun: If any P1 we defer, I'll add mitigation steps in the ticket and a temporary toggle if possible.
Nina: Labels added in tracker: hotpatch-candidate, urgent-nextminor, investigate-ML, customer-commit.
Aria: One more: if a customer-committed fix is >L effort, open a comms thread with Customer Success before deferring.
Felix: Noted. I'll draft the comms template for deferred enterprise fixes.
Aria: Thanks team. Quick cadence here keeps the next minor predictable. Post updates if you can't attend the sync.
